messages.subject: gvisTable not rendering a dataframe
parts:
I have a data.frame df1 which renders properly inside a gvisTable(Data()$df) call. But if I bind various rows and columns to it, call it df2, it fails to render at all.

is.data.frame(df1) and is.data.frame(df2) both return TRUE

both df1 and df2 display properly inside a renderTable({})

What should I be looking for besides is.data.frame(df1) ?

I'd be grateful for any suggestions. Thanks.


This looks like the same problem described here:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/gvisTable$20renderGvis/shiny-discuss/ho1oPrJTb5s/2iPQ6XYjIhwJ

messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: Re: gvisTable not rendering a dataframe
parts:
I had wrapped one of the dataframes with _format_, as in

rbind(format(df3),df4)

Removing _format_ revealed the dataframe header and several cells, but some cells remain empty.

The pattern is like this:

return(as.data.frame(df3)) -> ok

return(as.data.frame(df4)) -> ok

return(as.data.frame(rbind(df3,df4))) -> df3 cells show, but df4 cells don't show

return(as.data.frame(rbind(format(df3),df4))) -> nothing shown at all

so I'm still searching for a solution. Any suggestion welcome, thanks!

messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: Re: gvisTable not rendering a dataframe
parts:
It was the format() function that was messing things up.

I had another instance of format() I hadn't spotted, hidden in a function.

Either removing all format() around the data.frames or wrapping all the data.frames in a format worked.


return(as.data.frame(rbind(
format(df3),format(df4)))) -> works
